1.title: Which Senate Candidates Are Skipping Trump’s Republican Convention?
1.summary: For G.O.P. candidates in the most competitive races, deciding whether to appear with President Trump can be tricky. Some are going, while others are staying away.

2.title: Paxton Aide Turned Whistle-Blower Appears in Ad Endorsing His Rival, Talarico
2.summary: David Maxwell was among the staffers in the Texas attorney general’s office who accused Ken Paxton of abusing the power of his office, allegations that led to his impeachment. Mr. Paxton was acquitted.

3.title: A Hacking Tool Built With A.I. Can Breach Phones Without a Click
3.summary: An attack discovered by A.I. researchers could have compromised hundreds of millions of devices within hours, experts said.

4.title: Rubio Plans to Push Colombia’s New Leader to Tackle Cocaine Trade
4.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio — who is visiting Colombia, Ecuador and Peru this week — says he will talk to leaders about targeting drug-trafficking “terrorists,” and trade deals.

5.title: Iceland Summons U.S. Ambassador Over Provocative Trump Map
5.summary: After voting against talks to join the European Union, Iceland is reacting forcefully to a slight against its sovereignty.

6.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
6.summary: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"
